steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars
steps.body: Cream together **1 pound butter**, **1½ cups sugar**, **2 cups brown sugar**, **3 eggs** and **2 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Blend, add to the creamed ingredients, and mix in **½ tsp salt**, **6 cups flour** and **1½ tsp baking soda**.

steps.title: Add the mix-ins
steps.body: Add **4–6 cups chocolate chips** and **2 cups nuts**, optional.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place on the baking pan in desired size, and bake for 14 minutes at 350°F.
